delivery_notes: Runtime integration: copy audio/, licenses/, this manifest, and CREDITS.md as needed. Originals/, proof/, and Python scripts are provenance/work files, not runtime payload.
Each ambience is a 40-second stereo circularly crossfaded edit. All one-shots are mono.
Three creature cues derive from three different source files. Neither source hashes nor selected original filenames match the pre-v1.8 audio manifest.
Duration is the Ogg container duration. The raw FFmpeg decode duration is separately retained because Vorbis frame/padding handling can vary slightly for very short files.
Optional surge.ogg is included and separately licensed.
CC0-1.0.txt is the canonical CC0 legal code downloaded from https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode.txt.
